stack: Next.js 16.2 (App Router, Turbopack) + React 19, Tailwind CSS v4 (@theme tokens in globals.css), Recharts, three.js; Postgres via pg; HMAC-signed cookie sessions (no Supabase); Node ingest worker fed by RuView simulator containers (docker-compose)

surfaces.name: Main app, branded "AXLE · REKA Operations Console" (the facilities team's console; the brand kit treats this as the customer app)
entry_files: app/components/AppShell.tsx:104-185 (shell: sidebar, mobile drawer, mobile top bar, SimBadge)
surfaces.layout: Left sidebar 224px (Tailwind w-56) on lg (>=1024px), full height, not sticky (sidebar footer sits at the bottom of the page, scrolls with content). No desktop top bar. A full-width amber 'SIMULATED DATA' banner sits at the top of the content column on every page. Below lg: slim top bar (hamburger + AXLE wordmark) and a 256px (w-64) left drawer with a 60% black scrim. Content max width 1220px on the dashboard.

brand.logo: AxleMark: inline SVG hub-and-spokes glyph ("an axle, end-on"), 28px, amber accent #fb9800 (app/components/Logo.tsx:4-37). Favicon is the stock Next.js favicon.ico
brand.name_text: AXLE (bold, tracking 0.06em, the L in amber)
brand.other: Page subtitles hard-code the site name 'REKA HQ' (Dashboard.tsx:122). Login subtitle 'REKA Operations Console' (login/page.tsx:44). OnboardingChecklist heading 'Get AXLE ready'. Device catalog copy 'Every sensor type AXLE supports'. localStorage key axle_nav_collapsed. No version or build text.

Dashboard KPIs go 4 columns to 2; panels go 3 columns to 1.
surfaces.active_state: Active item: bg panel2 #202a22, text ink #eef2ec, font-medium, icon turns amber #fb9800; inactive text dim #a9b6ac with faint icon #6f7d73; hover bg panel2/60. Live is active only on exact '/'; Devices and Settings use prefix match. No aria-current.

colours.body glows: radial green rgba(45,106,79,.22) top-left, amber rgba(251,152,0,.07) top-right

surfaces.fonts: Poppins 400-800 (UI, --font-poppins) and JetBrains Mono 400-600 (numbers, eyebrows, tags) via next/font/google. Nav items 13px, group labels mono 9.5px uppercase 0.12em tracking. Nav icons 18px.
surfaces.a11y: Focus ring only on input/select/textarea (green #4f9d76 border + 2px 25% halo, globals.css:70-77); no focus style on links/buttons, and no AntaraX blue ring. No prefers-reduced-motion handling; skeleton shimmer loops forever (globals.css:51-60) and panels animate in (axle-rise). Drawer buttons have aria-labels; nav has no aria-current. Dark only. html lang='en'.
surfaces.role_variants: Two roles: admin and viewer (session.role). The nav is identical for both. Differences are in-page: viewers lose 'Edit layout' on the live map, device add/edit/toggle/delete, alert-rule editing, user management, zone calibration; admin-only APIs return 403. Any signed-in user can open the client view.

brand_gaps: The whole customer app is branded AXLE: tab title 'AXLE · REKA Operations Console' (app/app/layout.tsx:18-19), AxleMark + 'AXLE' wordmark + 'REKA · OPERATIONS' eyebrow in the sidebar, drawer and mobile bar (AppShell.tsx:148,160,176-178), sign-in 'REKA Operations Console' (login/page.tsx:44), client view 'REKA · CLIENT' eyebrow and titles 'Your space · AXLE' / 'Reports · AXLE', print report 'AXLE Monthly Space Report' and 'REKA Inisiatif · AXLE' (print/monthly/page.tsx:7,119,211), 'Get AXLE ready' onboarding, 'Every sensor type AXLE supports'. Brand kit: AXLE is internal and must never be shown to customers; most urgent fix in the portfolio.
No PLExyz Crowd mark (plexyz-crowd-mark.svg) and no 'by AntaraX' credit anywhere; stock Next.js favicon.

Colours are the old concept mock (amber #fb9800 on green-black #0e1310) instead of the PLExyz line violet #2C09B2 / Crowd accent #6040CC; status colours are local (#e2574c, #4f9d76) not the shared ok #12B76A / warn #F79009 / fault #F04438.
Dark only; brand kit 13 §10 requires light first for customer products (only AXLE is dark-only).
Focus ring is green and limited to form fields; brand kit wants AntaraX blue #0459F7 as the focus ring everywhere. No reduced-motion handling; infinite shimmer and entrance animations.
Uppercase mono eyebrows with tight tracking (REKA · OPERATIONS) instead of intan eyebrows in violet; tag chips in caps.
No help, guide, support contact or app tile (13 §8).
Hard-coded 'REKA HQ' site name on Live and the client view, and 'Floor 2' in the map title, instead of the organisation and the selected floor.
Words: 'Client view' and 'Users' should be organisation and members (13 §1); US spelling 'Analyze' as a nav group label and 'summarized' (British: Analyse, summarised).
Locked panels say 'UNLOCKED AT TIER N' and show prices ('from RM 350/zone', '+RM 30–50/zone/mo'); the brief says pricing is not published and 'unlock' is a banned upsell word in 03.

Dashboard shows panels for falls, safety alerts, through-wall sensing and 3D pose with vitals (heart rate): the brief lists these under 'Never say' and asks for heart-rate screens to be kept out of every demo. They render locked with the simulator, but still name the capabilities.

Simulated-data banner text names the vendor stack ('RuView Docker simulator'), and the client view has no simulated-data disclosure at all, though the brief makes 'the demo is simulated' a required disclosure.
Client view shows an 'admin →' link to every role, so customers can reach the operations console from it.
Error copy is lower-case API text ('login failed', 'API unreachable. Is the stack running?') rather than the error pattern.
notes: No separate internal AXLE console exists in this repo. The (dashboard) route group calls itself the 'admin/operational surface' in code comments (lib/nav.ts:24, ClientShell.tsx:7), but it is single-organisation, gated only by admin/viewer roles, has no cross-organisation controls, and is what customers sign in to; so it is inventoried as the customer surface, per the brand kit. The (client) group is a second, read-only customer surface. The worker (worker/) has no UI. /print/monthly is a server-rendered report that queries Postgres directly, so it was not captured. The repo's last commit is 21 July 2026 and the brand kit marks the product 'not in active development'.
